page_title: BOU 1-1 WHU | Bournemouth v West Ham 12/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Peter Bankes has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Chris Mepham (Bournemouth) is booked by the referee.
90+7' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Neto intercepts the ball.
90+6' Flag goes up against Maxwel Cornet (West Ham) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+4' Substitution. Maxwel Cornet (West Ham) on for Lucas Paqueta.
90+4' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is given a yellow card.
90+3' West Ham are ruled offside.
90+1' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bournemouth.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
87' The foul by Emerson (West Ham) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Peter Bankes.
86' Substitution. Pablo Fornals will be replaced by Thilo Kehrer (West Ham).
86' Neto (Bournemouth) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
86' POST! Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was!
85' The corner is swung in but West Ham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

85' Danny Ings (West Ham) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. West Ham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

82' 1 - 1 Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) weaves his way past several defenders and finds himself in a one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy throws the keeper off balance and he simply puts the ball into the back of net.
80' Kieffer Moore (Bournemouth) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
78' David Moyes has decided to substitute Michail Antonio and he is replaced by Danny Ings (West Ham).
75' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) replacing David Brooks.
75' Here's the change. Maximillian Aarons leaves the pitch and James Hill (Bournemouth) comes on as a substitute.
74' Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
72' Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
72' David Brooks (Bournemouth) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
71' David Brooks (Bournemouth) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
67' The substitution is prepared. Kieffer Moore (Bournemouth) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ryan Christie.
65' Joe Rothwell (Bournemouth) latches on to a sweet pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a brilliant shot towards the goal, but he hits the crossbar!
65' Bournemouth quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

65' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. The ball is out of play and Bournemouth manage to earn a corner.
62' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bournemouth comes to nothing.
61' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Philip Billing (Bournemouth) as his effort only hit the wall. Bournemouth force a corner. They send men into the box.
60' Marcos Senesi is being substituted because of an injury. Andoni Iraola sends Chris Mepham (Bournemouth) on the pitch.
60' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul. Bournemouth earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
60' Today's match ends for Jaidon Anthony who will be replaced by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth).
58' The game is interrupted now, Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
57' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
56' Bournemouth can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

56' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Alphonse Areola is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. The linesman makes the right call and Bournemouth will have a corner.
55' Bournemouth failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

51' 0 - 1 Goal! Tomas Soucek finds Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the top left corner. Fantasy football! 0:1.
51' David Brooks (Bournemouth) attempts a lovely volley under the crossbar, but it's saved by the keeper.
50' The ball goes behind for a corner. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
49' Michail Antonio (West Ham) receives a yellow card for infringement.
48' Peter Bankes blows his whistle. Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) commits a foul after dangerous play.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Peter Bankes blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Jaidon Anthony (Bournemouth) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Bournemouth take a short corner kick.
43' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

42' David Brooks (Bournemouth) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
41' David Brooks (Bournemouth) whips in a cross from the corner, but Alphonse Areola is well positioned and punches the ball away.

40' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bournemouth, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
39' The referee shows the yellow card to Jarrod Bowen (West Ham).
38' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the left side of the goal, but Neto was alert and made an amazing save!

36' What a great effort! Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches over the crossbar. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.

35' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) rose high to meet a perfectly taken corner kick and attempted to steer a fine header from inside the box towards the left side of the goal. Nobody knows what would have happened if one of the defending players hadn’t pulled off a brilliant intervention to block the effort.
35' Good work from West Ham as they win a corner.
35' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
34' A lofted cross from David Brooks (Bournemouth) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
31' David Brooks (Bournemouth) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

30' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
30' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Alphonse Areola comes off the line to clear the ball away.
29' Pablo Fornals (West Ham) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked.
29' Joe Rothwell (Bournemouth) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
28' Emerson (West Ham) brings his opponent down. Peter Bankes has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Bournemouth.
27' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Alphonse Areola was alert and made a comfortable save.
26' David Brooks (Bournemouth) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
26' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. It will be a corner kick for Bournemouth.
25' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) leaps above the defender and heads the ball goalwards from a corner by Jarrod Bowen, but his effort from the penalty spot flies well over the bar.
24' The ball is out of play. West Ham will have a chance to score from a corner.
24' Michail Antonio (West Ham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
22' Handball by Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham).
20' Jarrod Bowen sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Tomas Soucek (West Ham), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
20' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to West Ham.
20' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
18' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.
17' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) wasted a clear opportunity. He fired a first-time shot from point-blank range, but it rattled the right post.
16' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
14' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
13' My Gran could have done better! David Brooks (Bournemouth) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
12' Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
10' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
9' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) sends a long ball forward to Jaidon Anthony, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
8' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) commits a rough challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Peter Bankes blows for a foul after Jaidon Anthony (Bournemouth) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
6' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) shows brilliant individual skill to find some space and tries his luck from long range, but the shot flies well wide of the right post.
4' Pablo Fornals (West Ham) horribly skewed a first-time shot from the edge of the box and sent the ball way wide of the right post.
3' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
2' Kurt Zouma (West Ham) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bournemouth will have the kick-off.
Peter Bankes will referee today's match.
